message_def.name: Shutdown
message_def.description: This message is used to cause the receiving component to free all of the resources allocated to its process by the system and then to shutdown.

fixed_field.name: MessageID
fixed_field.interpretation: A two byte field to hold the message ID of a message

message_def.name: Standby
message_def.description: This message is used to transition the receiving component to the standby state.

fixed_field.name: MessageID
fixed_field.interpretation: A two byte field to hold the message ID of a message

message_def.name: Resume
message_def.description: This message is used to transition the receiving component to the ready state.

fixed_field.name: MessageID
fixed_field.interpretation: A two byte field to hold the message ID of a message

message_def.name: Reset
message_def.description: This message is used to cause the receiving component to reinitialize.

fixed_field.name: MessageID
fixed_field.interpretation: A two byte field to hold the message ID of a message

message_def.name: SetEmergency
message_def.description: This message is used to alert the component to a safety critical situation. The component that sends the emergency command shall set the message priority to the safety critical priority range as defined by the Transport. Receive of the emergency command shall result in the component transitioning into the emergency state.

fixed_field.name: MessageID
fixed_field.interpretation: A two byte field to hold the message ID of a message

message_def.name: ClearEmergency
message_def.description: This message shall notify the receiving component that the current emergency condition is to be reset and that the component shall transition back to the Ready or Standby state, provided that all emergency conditions have been cleared. JAUS currently defines only one emergency condition, the "Stop" condition. Future versions of this document could define other emergency conditions.

fixed_field.name: MessageID
fixed_field.interpretation: A two byte field to hold the message ID of a message

message_def.name: QueryStatus
message_def.description: This message is used by clients of this service to query the state of this service.

fixed_field.name: MessageID
fixed_field.interpretation: A two byte field to hold the message ID of a message

message_def.name: ReportStatus
message_def.description: This message is used to report the current status of the sender of the message.

fixed_field.name: MessageID
fixed_field.interpretation: A two byte field to hold the message ID of a message

fixed_field.name: Reserved
fixed_field.interpretation: This field is reserved for compatibility with previous versions of the Standard.
